svg.title: How to choose whether to change only one Google Calendar recurring event or the entire series
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
How to choose whether to change only one Google Calendar
recurring event or the entire series
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-11-05
Decide first whether the change
applies only once
If you are postponing only this week’s meeting
by one day because of a holiday or changing only
this week’s location, that is a one-time…
Check whether the change will continue
in the future
If future events will continue to change—for
example, if the same meeting is moved to
Thursday afternoon starting next month—choose…
When you need to change the entire
series
“All events” or “All events in the series”
applies to both past and future events.
What to check when creating a new
recurrence rule
The official Help explains that recurring events
in Google Calendar have a limit of 730
occurrences.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
